content.comment_body: Hello, I was using a [product_name] with article number [article_no] and firmware version [version_no]. After I created and uploaded a new project, the device stopped working. Now, upon powering up, the screen is completely blank. If I press and hold the 'esc' key, I briefly see 'detecting...' for a few seconds before the screen turns off. The device also isn’t visible in [product_name] software. Is there a way to recover it?

I haven’t come across this exact problem before. What do you mean by 'blank screen' after switching on—does it mean absolutely nothing is displayed? Are you able to access the system menu of [product_name] at all?

The screen stays blank as soon as the device is powered up, with no display and no backlight. I cannot access any menus because nothing is visible. Only when pressing the ESC key, a 'detecting...' message appears for a few seconds. The LAN LED blinks more quickly if a cable is connected, and occasionally even when disconnected.

How did you transfer the program—was it via network cable or SD card? If you used an SD card, please check if any pins are bent and try to start the device without the SD card. If you used the network cable, try pinging the device; if it does not respond, it may be faulty. At that point, you may need to replace it.
Based on your description, it seems the [product_name] is defective. You should consider creating a support request.
I also believe the [product_name] is faulty. You will need to replace it.

analysis.insight_summary: After uploading a new project to the [product_name], users report that the device fails to boot, with a blank screen, no backlight, and the device not recognized by [product_name] software. Standard troubleshooting steps, such as checking the SD card and network connectivity, do not resolve the problem. The discussion leads to the conclusion that hardware failure is likely after the new project upload, with limited recovery options and unclear failure indicators.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable firmware updates and project uploads, clear and recoverable error states, and the ability to restore the device by using software or performing straightforward troubleshooting steps.
